Style/medium: clean 2D painted / pixel-friendly hybrid; friendly warm silhouette; restrained early-2000s office charm; cream inner surface, deep charcoal-teal outer edge, dusty mint secondary rim, tiny restrained coral and honey-gold accents; crisp edges that remain readable over an isometric pixel office.

Composition/framing: one front-facing wide rounded rectangle only, centered, symmetrical corners, uniform straight edges, generous transparent padding on all sides, no perspective, no cast shadow extending far beyond the frame, no neighboring objects.

Constraints: genuinely transparent background outside the frame; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logo; no watermark; no icons; no characters; no decorative scene; do not create a sprite sheet; keep corner decoration minimal and edge thickness consistent so the frame can be 9-sliced; clear silhouette at small UI scale.
Avoid: neon, glassmorphism, sci-fi HUD, mobile casino styling, glossy gem buttons, excessive bevels, illegible micro-detail.
